textos.DualSense mostrando a cor da barra de lu: DualSense showing the light bar color, the player LEDs, the pressed buttons and the trigger pressure
textos.DualSense pelo cabo USB, escondido do si: DualSense over USB cable, hidden from the system
textos.Esconde o controle do sistema enquanto e: Hides the controller from the system while it charges over the cable.
textos.Ligue o cabo USB para usar o modo carreg: Plug in the USB cable to use charge mode.
textos.Ativa o modo carregar assim que o cabo U: Turns on charge mode as soon as the USB cable is connected.
textos.aparece depois de alguns minutos: shows up after a few minutes
textos.Ainda não há histórico. Ele começa a apa: No history yet. It starts to show up after a few minutes with the controller on.
No readings in the last 48 hours.
textos.Como a barra de luz se comporta enquanto: How the light bar behaves while the controller charges. You can also change it from inside charge mode.
textos.A barra de luz só acende enquanto o cont: The light bar only lights up while the controller is in charge mode.
textos.Cor da luz no modo carregar. Setas esque: Charge mode light color. Left and right arrows change the hue, up and down change the saturation
A solid light doesn't blink or breathe.
textos.O controle fica escondido do sistema enq: The controller stays hidden from the system while it charges. Steam and games can't see it until you go back.
textos.Arraste na roda ou escolha uma cor pront: Drag on the wheel or pick a preset color.
textos.A cor segue a bateria: verde acima de 60: The color follows the battery: green above 60%, yellow above 25% and red below that.
textos.Cor da barra de luz. Setas esquerda e di: Light bar color. Left and right arrows change the hue, up and down change the saturation
The five dots below the touchpad.
A short buzz on both motors.
textos.Escolha o efeito de cada gatilho e ajust: Pick the effect for each trigger and set where it starts and ends along its travel.
textos.Curso livre, sem nenhum efeito. O gatilh: Free travel, no effect at all. The trigger behaves like it came from the factory.
No effect along the whole travel.
textos.Vai até o fim do curso: Goes to the end of the travel
textos.Ligue o DualSense no cabo USB ou pareie: Plug the DualSense into a USB cable or pair it over Bluetooth.
textos.O teste fica pausado no modo carregar: The test is paused in charge mode
textos.Enquanto carrega, o controle fica escond: While charging, the controller stays hidden from the system and only reports the battery. Go back to normal mode to test buttons, sticks and sensors.
textos.Cada botão fica verde depois de apertado: Each button turns green after being pressed once.
textos.Posição do analógico esquerdo com rastro: Left stick position with trail and circularity outline
textos.Posição do analógico direito com rastro: Right stick position with trail and circularity outline
textos.Gire o analógico encostado na borda, dev: Slowly rotate the stick against the edge for a few turns.
textos.Aperte L2 e R2 até o fim. O traço branco: Press L2 and R2 all the way. The white mark shows the deepest point each one has reached.
textos.Deslize um ou dois dedos e aperte para t: Slide one or two fingers and press to test the click.
textos.O motor esquerdo é o forte e o direito é: The left motor is the strong one and the right one is the weak one. Set the strength and send a pulse.
textos.Toca um bipe curto no alto-falante embut: Plays a short beep on the built-in speaker.
textos.Fale perto do controle e acompanhe o nív: Speak near the controller and watch the level.
textos.O alto-falante, o fone e o microfone do: The DualSense speaker, headphones and microphone only work with the controller connected over USB cable.
textos.O sistema não encontrou o áudio do contr: The system didn't find the controller audio. Unplug the USB cable and plug it back in to try again.
textos.Conecte um fone na entrada do controle p: Plug headphones into the controller jack first.
textos.Teste recomeçado. Os resultados foram ze: Test restarted. The results were cleared.
textos.Relatório pronto. Escolha onde salvar o: Report ready. Choose where to save the file.
textos.Guarde a cor da barra de luz e os efeito: Save the light bar color and the trigger effects under a name and switch with one click.
textos.Salva a cor atual e os modos do L2 e do: Saves the current color and the L2 and R2 modes.
textos.Escolha uma cor em Luzes e os efeitos em: Pick a color in Lights and the effects in Triggers, then give it a name up here.
textos.Segure PS + Options por 2 s para ligar o: Hold PS + Options for 2 s to turn charge mode on or off.
textos.Mostra um aviso quando a bateria ficar a: Shows a warning when the battery drops below the chosen level.
textos.Desligar sozinho no Bluetooth depois de: Turn off on Bluetooth by itself after
Counts the time without touching the controller.
textos.Desliga o DualSense agora. Para ligar de: Turns the DualSense off now. To turn it back on, press the PS button.
textos.Continuar rodando ao fechar a janela: Keep running when the window is closed
textos.Modo carregar automático, avisos de bate: Automatic charge mode, battery warnings and the shortcut keep working.
Opens hidden when you log in.
textos.Fecha de vez, inclusive em segundo plano: Closes for good, including in the background.
textos.Cabo detectado. Modo carregar ligado soz: Cable detected. Charge mode turned on by itself.
textos.Modo carregar ligado. O controle sumiu d: Charge mode on. The controller is gone from the system.
Playing a test sound on the headphones.
Playing a test sound on the speaker.
textos.funcionou, com dois dedos ao mesmo tempo: worked, with two fingers at once
